shots.description: Car chase toward the sunset: Mateo in the SCARLET ARROW, two police cruisers behind, helicopter overhead, full HUD with wanted stars and minimap.
Mateo on foot on Ocean Drive at golden hour, traffic and pedestrians around him, pastel hotels and palms.
Mateo aiming with the mission objective panel, gold beacon and minimap marker visible.
Title screen: PIER HEAT — Sunset Bay, with the city glowing behind it.
